C-OFFER-PUSH-CONFLICT-GUARD-20261118.Summary: Push refuses to overwrite a stream that was changed in Keitaro after the last Fetch Streams / Push (409 conflict).
C-OFFER-PUSH-CONFLICT-GUARD-20261118.Problem: Review finding F3: Push replaces the Keitaro offer list unconditionally, so offers added or reweighted directly in Keitaro after our fetch are silently lost.

Goals.Goal: Before PUT, push_stream compares Keitaro's current offers (offer id, share, state) with the stream's published snapshot (offers with in_keitaro); any difference raises ConflictError (HTTP 409, code conflict) and nothing is written to Keitaro.
The 409 response is declared on the push endpoint in the API contract; the UI shows the message, which tells the user to press Cancel, then Fetch Streams, and redo the draft.

Constraints.Constraint: No change to fetch/cancel semantics; tests are banned, evidence is gates plus a live conflict scenario.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No automatic merge of Keitaro changes into a draft.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Draft edit, then an offer change made directly in Keitaro, then Push returns 409 and Keitaro keeps the external change; Cancel + Fetch Streams + redo + Push succeeds.
Push without external changes still succeeds; make gate-backend, gate-frontend, gate-openapi and grace lint exit 0.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Gate output, contract diff with 409 on pushStream, live conflict scenario on a test_ponomaryov_* campaign.

Assumptions.Assumption: Requested by the user in chat on 2026-11-18 ("F3 вариант а").
